<b>Volatile Flintbeetles</b> is a [[Hunt Wishes|Hunt Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, which is available on the [[Bone Bottom]] Wishwall after [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] has visited either [[Greymoor]] or [[Shellwood]]. As Bone Bottom is destroyed in Act 3, this Wish is removed from the [[Tasks]] menu if uncompleted, though the [[Memory Locket]] it rewards will instead be found at [[Survivor's Camp]] on the ground for free.

== Wish ==
[[File:Flintgem.png|link=Flintgem|left|thumb|100x100px]]

To complete the Wish, Hornet must locate and slay three [[Flintbeetle]]s located in [[the Marrow]]. Their locations can be tracked by interacting with the odorous dung they leave behind.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Bone Bottom Wishwall.png!Location of the wishwall in Bone Bottom
| Image2 = Mapshot SS Flintbeetle.png!Locations of Flintbeetles in the Marrow. The starred location will only be used if the shortcut after the Bellshrine is open.
| Image3 = Screenshot SS Flintbeetle Tracking.png!Hornet tracking a Flintbeetle
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Memory Locket.png|link=Memory Locket|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After completing the Wish and turning in the Flintgems, Hornet is awarded with a [[Memory Locket]].

{{Clear}}
